Distance from TSS to nearest peak?

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
cluster_assignments = readRDS("../results/figure2/cluster_assignments.rds")

chip_locations = peaks_to_genes[["long_data"]] %>%
  filter(str_detect(peak_id, "RELApeak"))

df = left_join(
  chip_locations,
  cluster_assignments,
  by = "Gene"
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  mutate(distance_to_TSS = min(distance_to_TSS)) %>%
  select(-peak_id) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = shape, y = distance_to_TSS)
) +
  facet_wrap(~peak_sig) +
  geom_violin(
    scale = "width"
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.2,
    outliers = F
  ) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.5
  )

# ===== early and peak vs early and sustain =====

df_2h_kinetics = df %>%
  mutate(
    groupName = case_when(
      groupName %in% c("up_immediate", "up_early") ~ "transient peak",
      groupName %in% c("up_sustained") ~ "sustained expression"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(groupName))

ggplot(
  df_2h_kinetics, 
  aes(x = groupName, y = distance_to_TSS)
  ) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outliers = F) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, alpha = 0.3)

df_2h_kinetics %>% 
  filter(groupName == "sustained expression") %>% 
  pull(distance_to_TSS) %>% 
  summary()

df_2h_kinetics %>% 
  filter(groupName == "transient peak") %>% 
  pull(distance_to_TSS) %>% 
  summary()

car::leveneTest(distance_to_TSS~groupName, data = df_2h_kinetics)

t.test(distance_to_TSS~groupName, data = df_2h_kinetics, var.equal = TRUE)

# ===== mid and peak vs mid and sustain =====

df_6h_kinetics = df %>%
  mutate(
    groupName = case_when(
      groupName %in% c("up_mid") ~ "transient peak",
      groupName %in% c("up_mid-late") ~ "sustained expression"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(groupName))

ggplot(
  df_6h_kinetics, 
  aes(x = groupName, y = distance_to_TSS)
  ) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outliers = F) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, alpha = 0.3)

df_6h_kinetics %>% 
  filter(groupName == "sustained expression") %>% 
  pull(distance_to_TSS) %>% 
  summary()

df_6h_kinetics %>% 
  filter(groupName == "transient peak") %>% 
  pull(distance_to_TSS) %>% 
  summary()

car::leveneTest(distance_to_TSS~groupName, data = df_6h_kinetics)

t.test(distance_to_TSS~groupName, data = df_6h_kinetics, var.equal = F)

cleanup_objects()
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=3}
chip_locations = peaks_to_genes[["long_data"]] %>%
  filter(str_detect(peak_id, "RELApeak"))

chip_counts = peaks_to_genes[["long_data"]] %>%
  filter(str_detect(peak_id, "RELApeak")) %>%
  select(Gene) %>%
  count(Gene)

goi = ikba_dea %>%
  filter(condition == "naive", treatment == "IL1B", sig == "up") %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

df = ikba_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B", Gene %in% goi) %>%
  group_by(Gene, time) %>%
  mutate(
    fraction_naive = log2fold / (log2fold[condition == "naive"] + 0.1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

inhibited_genes = df %>%
  filter(condition == "Ad-IKBA", time == 6) %>%
  filter(fraction_naive <= 0.25) %>%
  pull(Gene)

set.seed(777)
random_genes = ikba_dea %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sample(810)

df = rbind(
  
  chip_locations %>%
    filter(Gene %in% inhibited_genes) %>%
    mutate(group = "NFkappaB-dependent"),
  
  chip_locations %>%
    filter(Gene %in% random_genes) %>%
    mutate(group = "random")
)

ggplot(
  df, 
  aes(x = group, y = distance_to_TSS)
) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F, width = 0.2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "peak distance from TSS")

df = rbind(
  
  chip_counts %>%
    filter(Gene %in% inhibited_genes) %>%
    mutate(group = "NFkappaB-dependent"),
  
  chip_counts %>%
    filter(Gene %in% random_genes) %>%
    mutate(group = "random")
)

ggplot(
  df, 
  aes(x = group, y = n)
) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F, width = 0.2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "number of peaks within 30kb of TSS")
```
